status: Landscape complete; fresh portrait review pending. No runtime, build, handbook or score changes between reviewers.

originalScores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 functional with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 10 exceptionally clear and comfortable across assessed content. Holistic judgment, not outcome-derived or arithmetic average; no desired score.

reasons.overall_mobile: Clear objective progression and attractive coherent station presentation, with reliable visible assist completion across two runs. Repeated manual aim corrections limit confidence in mobile combat comfort.
reasons.controls: Large labeled controls and tap aim helped. Two-contact patrol drag needed correction in both attempts. DASH activation/cooldown observed, effective evade not proven. Zoom works, but sustained rearming cannot be judged.
reasons.gameplay: Recoveries, timed coil vulnerability, reload pressure and deck hold supplied distinct observable tasks. Assisted route reduced navigation effort. Two wins do not establish difficulty balance or uninterrupted enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rainy station, teal/orange feedback, gun view, environmental names and recovery result gave a coherent visual identity. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Route/approach labels, directional threat prompts, phase labels, auto reload and transparent assist counts were useful. Untreated rear enemies created pressure while focus stayed on coils.
reasons.readability: Objective, health/ammo, target feedback and results were legible at 844x390. World signage and distant enemies were much smaller and lower contrast; overlays occupy appreciable scene space.
